estimands.theta_both: macro of the per-round best leaderboard system minus macro of the per-round best generator; this is the Proposition 4 identity statistic
estimands.theta_fixed: macro of the point-estimate winner (fixed across rounds) minus macro of the per-round best generator; this is what the native tool prints as margin_ci

gates.detail: recomputed fixed-winner statistic equals the recorded native margin point estimate, ceiling, and 95% interval for all four m25 tasks
theta_both is exactly zero in every valid bootstrap round and its percentile interval is the degenerate [0, 0] on all four m25 tasks
theta_fixed is never positive in any valid round: the frozen winner cannot exceed the per-round best generator

non-producer control: injected system scores exactly 100.0 on U, is the point leader, and theta_both is strictly positive with a non-degenerate interval; unranked-generator control: theta_both is strictly negative in at least one round with lo95 < 0 <= hi95, so the [0,0] degeneracy of the main condition is not automatic
an unmodified rerun of the native tool on the rebuilt table reproduces the recorded margin interval
